title: Opening, introductions and Harris's birth in St. James Parish
summary: Interviewer introduces those present and Harris gives his name, address and birthplace near Laplace, Louisiana.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape

blocks.x: We're interviewing Mr. Joe Harris today and Harold Dajon is here and Bill Russell and Ralph Collins. What is the address? 3905 Chapitula. 3905 Chapitula. Can you give your full name Mr. Harris? Have any middle name or initial? Joseph Dennis Harris. Do you mind telling just when you were born and where? I was born in Lutche, Louisiana, St. James Parish, April 24th, 1999. That's St. James? St. James. That's on the other side of the river? On this side. It's on this side? Yes. It's up near Laplace? About five or six miles out of Laplace. I was thinking St. James is across the river. Well you have Laplace on that side of Laplace.
St. James across the river, Laplace across the river, on both sides of the river.
And what's the other town up there where Kid Thomas came? Reserve? Is it up near there too? Yeah, that's on the other side of Reserve. Up that way.
Yeah, well, yeah. What was the exact birthday? April the 24th. April 21st. Yes. Can you tell us about your folks? Did any of them play music?
